title: Week 19 Updates: Plugin Support & Enhanced Git Workflows
description: Claude Code v2.1.128–v2.1.136 (May 4–8, 2026) introduces plugin loading from .zip archives and URLs, worktree baseRef configuration, auto mode hard deny rules, and hooks that see active effort level. Previous weeks brought Windows PowerShell support, ultrareview cloud code review, and project purge tools.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is great when you want agent-level edits but also need to eyeball a bunch of files side by side

title: Cloud Agent Development Environments
description: Cursor released major updates on May 13, 2026, introducing development environments for cloud agents with multi-repo support, Dockerfile-based configuration with build secrets, and improved agent-led environment setup. Also released Microsoft Teams integration and Bugbot effort level customization on May 11, followed by PR review experience improvements and parallel plan execution on May 7.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code vs Cursor: two philosophies, not two versions of the same thing - Claude Code is a terminal-native execution agent, Cursor is an AI-augmented IDE
Cursor acts as a partner where you stay in control, while Claude Code runs 30-minute autonomous sessions

title: v1.3.38: Config Management and Security Fixes
description: Continue released v1.3.38-vscode with features including .continue/configs support, session history filtering by workspace directory, and critical security vulnerability resolutions. Recent versions added ClawRouter provider for cost-optimized model routing, Responses API opt-out option, OpenRouter improvements with Gemini 3 tool support, and extensive bug fixes for JetBrains and VSCode integrations.

title: April 2026: Agentic Workflows in VS Code
description: GitHub Copilot released April 2026 updates for Visual Studio Code (v1.116-v1.119, released May 6) focusing on agentic workflows with cloud agent sessions, custom agent capabilities, and Visual Studio April updates. GPT-4.1 was deprecated across Copilot experiences with GPT-5.5 as the recommended alternative.

title: Devin Review API & MCP Enhancements
description: Devin released numerous updates throughout early 2026 including the Devin Review API for programmatic PR reviews, Mermaid diagram rendering, per-PR auto-review toggles, sidebar session notifications, service user permission management, MCP secret scoping, and Ask Devin in PR discussions. Major features include stacked review permissions, skill slash commands, auto-fix with CI checks integration, and session categorization.

title: v0.86.0: GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Aider v0.86.0 added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Preview, and improved commit message output readability. Recent versions (v0.83.0-v0.85.0) added extensive new model support including Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash series, o1-pro, o3-pro, Deepseek models, thinking tokens support, and 130 new programming languages with linter support.
